related_questions.question: What cruise ship did people get sick on?

text_blocks.snippet: Several cruise ships have recently experienced gastrointestinal illness outbreaks. Specifically, Royal Caribbean's Navigator of the Seas reported over 140 passengers and crew falling ill with vomiting, stomach cramps, and diarrhea. Additionally, Royal Caribbean's Radiance of the Seas also had a gastrointestinal illness outbreak with dozens of passengers and crew affected. Other ships like the Queen Mary 2 (Cunard Line) and a Holland America Line ship have also reported outbreaks.

list.title: Queen Mary 2:
